options.description: The router the keys come from, which the list needs to hold them while it is open.
options.name: input

options.description: The choices: strings, `Choice`s, and separators, as `select()` takes them.
options.name: options

options.description: Draw the arrow and the list with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says.
options.name: ascii

options.description: Whether it refuses input. A disabled dropdown is out of the focus ring, opens nothing and is drawn muted. A `State<boolean>` is read live. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: disabled

options.description: Called with the value after a pick that changed it. Not called for a write the app made.
options.name: onChange

options.description: Shown, muted, while nothing is chosen.
options.name: placeholder

options.description: The field's own props: a class, a margin. Geometry only, never a colour.
options.name: props

options.description: How many columns the field takes, brackets and arrow included. Defaults to what the widest choice needs, so the field does not change width as the value does.
options.name: width
